3. Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs): These medications can also help reduce inflammation in the joints and alleviate pain. Examples include naproxen (Aleve) and celecoxib (Celebrex).
4. Surgery: In some cases, surgery may be necessary to address the underlying cause of your back pain, such as herniated discs or spinal stenosis.

6. Massage therapy: This can help relax tight muscles and promote healing by breaking up scar tissue and reducing inflammation.
7. Lifestyle changes: Maintaining a healthy weight, getting regular exercise, and avoiding excessive stress can all contribute to better overall health and reduced risk of chronic pain.
